docs.title: Deployment & Installation
docs.text: This guide covers the standard procedure for deploying the Codexmetry using Docker Compose.

docs.title: 1. Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before initializing the installation, ensure your host environment meets the following requirements:

  • Docker & Docker Compose: Installed and running.
  • Network Ports:
    • 5001: Application Interface.
    • 5432: Internal Database Engine (isolated by default).
  • Architecture: x86_64 or ARM64 (PostgreSQL 17 compatible).

docs.title: Step 1: Create the Project Environment
docs.text:
Establish a dedicated directory to serve as the host anchor for your data volumes and configuration files.

mkdir codexmetry && cd codexmetry

docs.title: Step 2: Acquire Orchestration Files
docs.text:
Download the mandatory environment template and the Docker Compose manifest directly from the official repository.

# Download the environment template
curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhjang101/codexmetry/main/.env.example -o .env

# Download the compose file
curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhjang101/codexmetry/main/compose.yaml -o compose.yaml

docs.title: Step 3: Configure Environment Variables
docs.text:
Edit the .env file to establish your unique system credentials.

!!! danger "Security Requirement" You must change the INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD and generate a unique SECRET_KEY. To generate a high-entropy key, run the following command in your terminal: python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))'

nano .env

docs.title: Step 4: Launch the Fortress
docs.text:
Initialize the containers. The engine will automatically detect the empty database and perform the initial schema migration and system record seeding.

docker compose up -d

docs.title: 3. Post-Deployment Verification
docs.text:
Once the containers are active, you can verify the integrity of the installation:

  1. UI Access: Navigate to http://localhost:5001.
  2. Logs: Check the system initialization log for any database errors: bash docker compose logs -f app
  3. Root Login: Use the credentials defined in your .env file to access the Admin dashboard.

docs.title: 4. Data Persistence & Volumes
docs.text:
Codexmetry is designed for data durability. By default, your data is mapped to a ./data directory within your project folder:

Container Path Host Path (Local) Forensic Purpose /var/lib/postgresql/data ./data/postgres Physical Database storage. /app/app/static/uploads ./data/uploads Documents, Images, and Attachments. /app/app/backups ./data/backups SQL Snapshots and System Archives. /app/app/logs ./data/logs Forensic Audit and System Logs.

!!! warning "Permissions" If the application cannot save uploads or backups, ensure the host directory permissions are correctly aligned with your Docker user: sudo chown -R $USER:$USER ./data

docs.title: 5. Maintenance Commands
docs.text: Action Command Stop System docker compose stop Restart System docker compose restart Update Image docker compose pull && docker compose up -d Complete Wipe docker compose down -v (Warning: Deletes all data!)
